prompts: Edit target: the supplied human sprite parts atlas. Produce a completely redrawn improved production 2D skeletal-game parts atlas, preserving the adult man identity, right-facing orthographic profile, charcoal short sleeved tee, khaki trousers, dark low shoes, natural colors and realistic painted texture. EXACTLY 4 columns and 4 rows, 16 well-separated parts with generous transparent gutters. Row-major layout must remain: 1 headless armless torso and pelvis; 2 head RIGHT profile with ONE eye and NO long neck; 3 thigh; 4 shin; 5 right-facing shoe; 6 short neck; 7 pelvis cloth patch; 8 upper arm with short tee sleeve; 9 forearm; 10 relaxed right-profile hand; 11 elbow skin patch; 12 wrist skin patch; 13 alternative relaxed hand; 14 alternative shoe; 15 knee khaki patch; 16 shoulder charcoal patch. Essential redesign: every attachment end is a SMOOTH ROUNDED 2D SILHOUETTE, like the overlap caps of polished articulated robot parts, but with HUMAN skin and cloth. NO STRAIGHT TRANSVERSE CUTS. Thigh: rounded convex hip end and semicircular knee end. Shin: semicircular knee end and rounded ankle end. Upper arm: convex shoulder dome and rounded elbow end. Forearm: semicircular elbow end and rounded wrist end. Hand: rounded wrist extending into forearm overlap. Neck: soft capsule with rounded top and bottom, same skin tone. These hidden overlap caps extend beyond the internal pivot by at least the local half-width and are fully filled with matching skin/cloth, smooth uniform local shading, no dark ring or transverse contour. No severed anatomy, cross-sections, cut faces, open tubes, plugs, metal sockets, exposed joints, ball hardware or labels. Torso has no attached arm/sleeve, neutral single-shoulder right profile; pelvis bottom is a curved khaki silhouette for thigh overlap. 11,12,15,16 are simple natural material discs with soft round silhouette, no seams or mechanical detail. Limbs straight vertical proximal TOP distal BOTTOM with natural taper. Existing atlas has bad straight cuts: replace these, do not preserve them. Flat 2D silhouette, not disconnected product photography. True transparent alpha, no colored fringes, no floating specks, no shadows cast outside parts. No complete assembled character, text, grid, watermark.

Edit target supplied rounded human atlas. Preserve its 4x4 part layout, realistic adult man with charcoal tee, khaki trousers and dark shoes, STRICT orthographic right facing profile, all existing smooth curved joint silhouettes and filled overlapping caps. Make ONLY these three improvements: (1) row1 col1 torso must be truly armless: remove the attached sleeve silhouette/protruding arm shape from torso and replace with a clean tight side torso shoulder/chest contour; sleeve exists solely on row2 col4 upper-arm sprite. Keep its curved pelvis end. (2) row4 col1 replace alternative relaxed hand with a CLOSED FIST in right-facing side profile, knuckles facing RIGHT, wrist rounded at TOP, compact natural human fist with thumb folded across fingers, matching light skin tone; sufficient smooth capsule wrist overlap. (3) row2 col1 and row4 col2 shoe ankle skin must be SHORT and narrower, with a gently rounded top and without bulbous balloon, consistent ankle proportions. All other 13 tiles unchanged. No straight horizontal cut edges on any attachment. No rings, sockets, tissue cross-section, detached visible mechanical joints, labels, text, grid, shadows or specks. True transparent background and antialiased alpha. Preserve the transparency of target.
attachmentRule: rounded cap; pivot lies inside cap; redraw hidden overlap; do not cut across a limb
